description: This file defines the UriInterface interface in the Psr\Http\Message namespace, representing an immutable URI value object with methods for accessing and modifying URI components according to RFC 3986.

classes.name: UriInterface
classes.description: Interface representing an immutable URI object with methods to access and modify URI components.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme in lowercase, or an empty string if none.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority component in '[user-info@]host[:port]' format or empty string.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns user info in 'username[:password]' format or empty string.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component in lowercase or empty string.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port as an integer if non-standard, or null.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified user info.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the URI as a string, combining all components according to RFC 3986.
